page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re6p.26xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 104 dedicated vCPUs mapped directly to 104 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor, operating with a single thread per core. The instance is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 3.69 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include any local storage, requiring reliance on external network-attached storage solutions. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps. There are zero integrated graphics processing units on this instance, which limits its utility for hardware-accelerated rendering or deep learning workloads.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation without hyperthreading provides predictable compute performance, making it suitable for workloads sensitive to resource sharing. The balanced memory-to-core ratio and high core count align with multi-threaded processing tasks, large-scale web serving, container orchestration, and general-purpose enterprise applications that do not require local disk storage or GPU acceleration.
